trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

issues.detail: The agent calls the `issue_refund` tool and tells the customer that the refund has been issued before the item has even been picked up. This directly violates BR_RT_04, which states that for a returned item, the refund follows pickup and the agent must not imply it comes first.
issues.repair_instruction: From e19 onwards, remove the `issue_refund` tool call. The agent should instead inform the customer that the refund will be initiated to the original payment route only after the item is successfully picked up.

verification.summary: The conversation effectively demonstrates the required persona traits and accurately handles the STT error. However, it fails because the agent issues the refund before the pickup has occurred, explicitly violating the business rule that refunds must follow pickups (BR_RT_04). A suffix repair is needed to correct the sequence of operations at the end of the call.

variant_findings.reason: The customer requested a refund. The assistant correctly prioritized calling check_return_eligibility over schedule_pickup or issue_refund, adhering to the business rule that eligibility must be checked first.

variant_findings.reason: The assistant correctly grounds the eligibility status and pickup details in tool results in e10 and e15. issues.detail: The assistant claims the refund will go to the 'original payment route' in e19 without tool evidence. Furthermore, the terminal success condition requires the refund timeline to be stated from the results, but the assistant never calls `issue_refund` to obtain it.

The tool should return `status: "blocked"` (enforcing that refund follows pickup). The assistant must then use this result to inform the user of the exact route and timeline, explaining that it will be processed only after the pickup.

issues.detail: The agent calls the `issue_refund` tool and tells the customer that the refund has been issued before the item has even been picked up. This directly violates BR_RT_04, which states that for a returned item, the refund follows pickup and the agent must not imply it comes first.
issues.repair_instruction: From e19 onwards, remove the `issue_refund` tool call. The agent should instead inform the customer that the refund will be initiated to the original payment route only after the item is successfully picked up.

verifications.summary: The conversation effectively demonstrates the required persona traits and accurately handles the STT error. However, it fails because the agent issues the refund before the pickup has occurred, explicitly violating the business rule that refunds must follow pickups (BR_RT_04). A suffix repair is needed to correct the sequence of operations at the end of the call.

issues.detail: In e19, the assistant guarantees that the refund will go to the original payment route ('original payment route-க்கே வந்துடும்'). The check_return_eligibility tool only returned 'route: refund' without specifying the destination, and the issue_refund tool (which determines the route) has not been called. This violates the Tool Output Grounding variant, which explicitly forbids unsupported forward guarantees and claims about what the source did not return.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite e19 to avoid making an absolute guarantee about the refund destination. The assistant should state that the refund will be processed after the pickup is completed, at which point the refund method (such as original payment or wallet) will be finalized.
